name: Nergui
history: Nergui fue un grupo activo en 2017, de estilo nu metal con influencias de Ill Niño, Machine Head, Disturbed, Damageplan, Staind, Sevendust, Nonpoint, Mudvayne, Stereomud y Spineshank.
historyEn: Nergui was a band active in 2017, of nu metal style with influences of Ill Niño, Machine Head, Disturbed, Damageplan, Staind, Sevendust, Nonpoint, Mudvayne, Stereomud and Spineshank.
